""" def create_blog_post(heading: str, text: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a blog post for safe HTML rendering. """ if not isinstance(heading, str) or not isinstance(text, str): raise TypeError("Both heading and text must be strings.") # Escape special HTML characters to prevent XSS. safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Replace newlines with

") # Render the final HTML using the predefined format. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_heading, body=safe_text)
